patch_description: This design returns to the shallower, better-generalizing nearest-neighbor chain from the strongest prior result, while adding a sparse long-range chord layer instead of the current program’s costly second ring. Four CZ chords connect opposite halves of the register, allowing global correlations to propagate with substantially less depth and gate count. Parity-shared RZ phases before and after the chord layer provide trainable basis adaptation using only four additional parameter names, balancing expressivity, parameter efficiency, and regularization.
